problem: A target awaiting admission can consume a first legacy preedit letter before Ready. Installation clears it. Warm ordinary FocusIn retains the source owner during tentative Transfer; its different-context reply converts the exact request to SourceFree. The old Native/ownerless-only receipt missed this path.
decision: Capture immutable request, nonce, target, origin, optional native context hint and expected lifecycle in a typed PendingLiteral stamp under the existing reducer lock, before the retained-owner branch. SourceFree expects the current lifecycle; tentative Transfer expects the single canonical different-context fallback increment while retaining its exact request/nonce. Publish once in reducer-to-stamps order. Existing bounded rendezvous may recover only this exact-header non-authoritative stamp across owner replacement on the same live connection. Ordinary key/lifecycle epoch checks and Shift handling remain strict; no new wait, owner, queue, timer or delivery executor.
installation: Preserve only visible, active, nonsensitive legacy preedit with valid cursor, identical local tail, unchanged local focus serial and exact current SourceFree Ready request/nonce/revision/origin/target; require context equality whenever a hint was already supplied. CompatibilityProperty may acquire context through its authenticated reply. No Transfer or ResetUnknown grant may preserve this literal receipt. Retain UnknownStart; discard unproven, reset, replaced-request, sensitive or focus-replaced text.
callback_completion: A PendingLiteral callback grants no KeyCallback and cannot settle an edit. Recognize it with or without an already-installed owner and perform ordinary literal delivery. Do not pass it to settle(None), which would revoke a successor. An installed owner does not acquire a pending preservation receipt. Revocation still removes observed stamps; a disconnected or terminated observer cannot recover one.

alternatives.reason: Text equality does not prove acquisition identity and can restore outgoing or revoked text.
Requires a larger callback-scheduling change around the engine interface lock; feasibility and exactly-once delivery are not established by the supplied trace.

alternatives.option: Retain only authenticated pending-target literal preedit
alternatives.reason: Repairs the demonstrated shared installation reset using the current bounded stamp store and reducer identity, with no new input authority.
